verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an issue-tracking product, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Jira. The cited material covers only Jira Cloud features: Cloud REST APIs, Atlassian-hosted sandboxes, and cloud developer sites. Cloud sandboxes and demo sites are hosted environments, not self-hosting, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
